pages.title: Edge
pages.text:
**Claw.** Silent Gear blueprints, iron on your back, a bow, a portal frame. Leave the pad on purpose.\
Edge opens the braid: after Claw, Pattern, Colony, and Hum are all yours to choose from.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text: Open this stage in the quest screen. Complete its required tasks, claim the reward and seat its Strand token at the Tension Post. Check that the matching notch lights.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes show the current ingredients; the Spirit Codex covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and read the machine's diagnostic message.
